items.title: Rewriting Bun in Rust
items.raw_content: Disclosure: Bun was acquired by Anthropic in December 2025. I and others on the Bun team work at Anthropic. I used a pre-release version of Claude Fable 5 for much of the Rust rewrite. Bun started as a line-for-line port of esbuild's JavaScript & TypeScript transpiler from Go to Zig. I wrote my first line of Zig on April 16, 2021 . I bet on Zig after seeing the single-page Zig Language Reference on Hacker News and getting really excited about the low-level control and care for performance.
items.title_zh: 用 Rust 重写 Bun
items.summary: The Bun team recounts rewriting the Bun runtime in Rust, noting that Bun was acquired by Anthropic in December 2025 and that a pre-release version of Claude Fable 5 was used for much of the rewrite. The post traces Bun's origins as a line-for-line port of esbuild's JavaScript and TypeScript transpiler from Go to Zig, with the first Zig code written in April 2021.

items.title: So you want to learn physics (second edition, 2021)
items.raw_content: Nearly six years ago, I sat down at my desk and typed up a detailed guide for anyone who wanted to learn physics on their own. At the time, I had no idea how many people would read it and use it — my only goal was to put the information out there in a clear and straightforward way so that anyone who wanted to learn physics would have the self-study curriculum they needed. Since then, over six hundred thousand people have turned to this guide to study physics. According to the emails I’ve received from readers, many of you have gone on to get undergraduate degrees in physics after following the curriculum in this guide (some of you are even now in graduate programs!), but the majority of those who have bookmarked and followed this guide — even all the way to the end! — have done so out of pure curiosity and for the sheer joy of understanding the incredible universe we inhabit.
items.title_zh: 你想学物理吗（第二版，2021）
items.summary: The author looks back on a self-study physics curriculum written nearly six years ago that has since been used by more than 600,000 people. Reader emails suggest some went on to undergraduate or graduate physics programs, though most followed the guide out of curiosity.

items.title: Decoding the obfuscated bash script on a Uniqlo t-shirt
items.raw_content: When my wife said to me “Let me show you a t-shirt I saw…”, I wasn’t sure what to expect, but it definitely wasn’t an obfuscated bash script printed on the back designed to print a happy Easter egg message. I’m not in the habit of clickbaity headlines ⊕ I’ve no idea at all how many views this site gets, but I’m willing to bet it’s not even double-digit humans per month. but I can see why subeditors have such fun with them. The title above is, strictly speaking, entirely accurate, but probably not what you think. The obfuscated code in question is actually an easter egg, it’s being supplied via Uniqlo stores on an excellent t-shirt designed by Akamai in support of their Peace for All campaign .
items.title_zh: 破解 Uniqlo T 恤上的混淆 bash 脚本
items.summary: The author decodes an obfuscated bash script printed on the back of a Uniqlo t-shirt that prints a happy Easter egg message when run. The shirt was designed by Akamai for its Peace for All campaign.

items.title: Show HN: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents
items.raw_content: Data visualizations are the bridge between user and data. But building AI agents that can generate visualizations reliably can be very tricky: - simple chart specs can be reliable, but generated charts are often of low quality due to reliance on system defaults; - complex chart specs with explicit details can produce good-looking charts, but they are verbose and agents can struggle with reliability We figured out it is a limitation on the language issue (not just AI capability thing) -- current visualization languages are a bit too low-level for AI agents, requiring them to explicitly make visual decisions that are supposed to be handled by a good compiler. Flint is a visualization intermediate language to address this issue, allow AI agents to solve this last-mile human-agent interaction problem. It provides a simple semantic-type based specification, and contains a layout optimization
items.title_zh: Show HN：微软发布 Flint，一种面向 AI 智能体的可视化语言
items.summary: Microsoft released Flint, a visualization intermediate language for AI agents that uses a semantic-type-based specification and built-in layout optimization to make chart generation more reliable.

items.title: Beyond Thermal Imaging: Inferring Thermophysical Properties from Time-Resolved Thermal Observations
items.title_zh: 超越热成像：从时间分辨热观测中推断热物理性质
items.summary: The paper introduces ThermoField, a framework that couples spatially varying neural fields with a differentiable heat-transfer solver to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, estimate thermal diffusivity and predict thermal evolution from time-resolved thermal observations. It aims to connect thermal scene reconstruction with inverse heat-transfer analysis in complex 3D scenes.

items.title: Evaluating the Effect of Frame Rate in Sequence-Based Classification of Autism-Related Self-Stimulatory Hand Idiosyncrasies
items.title_zh: 评估帧率在自闭症相关自我刺激手部特异动作序列分类中的影响
items.summary: The study compares LSTM and GRU models trained on pose-derived features from the SSBD dataset at several frame sampling intervals, and separately ablates ten data augmentation strategies within an I3D transfer-learning pipeline for video-based detection of autism-related self-stimulatory behaviors. It also tests a personalized per-subject scheme trained and tested on temporally split segments of each video.

items.title: KronQ: LLM Quantization via Kronecker-Factored Hessian
items.title_zh: KronQ：基于 Kronecker 分解 Hessian 的 LLM 量化
items.summary: KronQ is a post-training quantization framework that adds gradient covariance to activation statistics under a Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation, contributing bidirectional incoherence processing on the output dimension and a new sensitivity metric for inter-layer mixed-precision allocation. In 2-bit weight-only quantization of LLaMA-3-70B the authors report 7.93 perplexity on WikiText-2, where GPTQ and GPTAQ are described as diverging or producing degenerate quantizations.

items.title: A Multi-cluster Boundary Learning Method for Out-of-Scope Intent Detection via MiniLM Embedding
items.title_zh: 基于 MiniLM 嵌入的多簇边界学习域外意图检测方法
items.summary: The paper proposes a one-class classification method that learns the boundaries of multiple embedding clusters produced by all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and rejects out-of-domain utterances as out-of-scope intents. Experiments on CLINC150, StackOverflow and Banking77 report state-of-the-art OOS intent detection performance relative to the compared baselines.

items.title: Right Answer, Wrong Tokens: Tail-Aware Credit Calibration for RLVR
items.title_zh: 答案正确、词元错误：面向 RLVR 的尾部感知信用校准
items.summary: The paper identifies a positive-credit contamination failure mode in GRPO-style reinforcement learning, where uniform credit assignment reinforces locally erroneous tail tokens inside successful trajectories, and proposes TACO, which uses a policy-relative tail-risk score to softly reduce positive credit for high-risk tokens while keeping it nonzero. Experiments across four LLMs and eight reasoning benchmarks are reported to improve over GRPO-style baselines and to improve training stability.

items.title: Agentic Neural Architecture Search
items.title_zh: 智能体式神经网络架构搜索
items.summary: The paper proposes a division of labor in which an LLM generates a seed architecture and decomposes it into a slotted architecture whose interchangeable module slots define a bounded, task-specific search space for conventional NAS, instantiated as the three-phase AgentNAS pipeline. On 17 tasks from NAS-Bench-360 and Unseen NAS, AgentNAS is reported to set a new state of the art on 11 tasks, with ablations indicating the two search mechanisms are broadly complementary.
